requirements.requirement: The system must render PI name, institution, trial count, publication indicator, and score contribution when all fields are present.
The system must correctly format trial count as a human-readable integer value in the UI.
The system must display a visual indicator for publication presence when publication data is true.
The system must accurately reflect PI score contribution consistent with backend-provided value.
The system must render the PI credibility component within the trial scorecard without breaking existing layout structure.
The system must not render empty or null fields and instead omit or replace them with a fallback label.
The system must display a fallback message when all PI data fields are missing.
The system must handle partial PI data by rendering available fields without UI errors.
The system must ensure no runtime errors occur when PI API response is null or undefined.
The system must maintain consistent styling and labeling with other scorecard components.
The system must validate that score contribution display matches the same value used in overall trial scoring logic.
The system must correctly render zero trial count without treating it as missing data.
The system must correctly render false publication indicator without displaying publication badge.
The system must pass all unit tests validating PI rendering logic transformations.
The system must pass integration tests validating end-to-end rendering from API response to UI display.
